en: I refused the new job in Rabat.
I didn't refuse my friend's help.
Why did you refuse the manager's offer?

ar: نتا ما رفضتيش الفلوس من عندو
en: You didn't refuse the money from him.
You (f.) refused your sister's idea.
You (f.) didn't refuse the teacher's request.
He refused the glass of tea.
He didn't refuse participating in the project.
She refused the invitation to the wedding.
She didn't refuse the gift from her brother.
We refused the conditions of the matchmakers.
We didn't refuse the father's advice.
Why did you (pl.) refuse our suggestion yesterday?

lat: ntuma ma rfedtush l-ittifaq m3a sh-sharika
ar: نتوما ما رفضتوش الاتفاق مع الشركة
en: You (pl.) didn't refuse the agreement with the company.
They refused the solution to the problem.
They didn't refuse entry to the market.
I always refuse coffee with sugar.

ar: ما كنرفضش المساعدة من عند الناس
en: I don't refuse help from people.
You refuse everything without a reason.
You don't refuse your mother's request.
Why do you (f.) always refuse the food here?

lat: nti ma katrefdish l-khedma f l-lil
en: You (f.) don't refuse working at night.
He refuses gifts from strangers.
He doesn't refuse advice from friends.

lat: hiya katrfed l-khedma bzaf f d-dar
en: She refuses the work at home a lot.
She doesn't refuse a picture with us.
We always refuse bad treatment.
We don't refuse guests in the house.
Why do you (pl.) refuse his idea?

lat: ntuma ma katrefdush l-musa3ada dyal l-jiran
ar: نتوما ما كترفضوش المساعدة ديال الجيران
en: You (pl.) don't refuse the neighbors' help.
They refuse the new law here.
They don't refuse talking with the director.

lat: ana ghadi nrfed l-kontrat l-jdid ghedda
ar: انا غادي نرفض الكونطرات الجديد غدا
en: I am going to refuse the new contract tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nrfed l-hdiya dyalek abadan
ar: ما غاديش نرفض الهدية ديالك ابدا
en: I am not going to refuse your gift ever.

lat: wash ghadi trfed l-khedma f l-kharij
en: Are you going to refuse the job abroad?

lat: nta ma ghadish trfed d-da3wa dyalu
ar: نتا ما غاديش ترفض الدعوة ديالو
en: You are not going to refuse his invitation.

lat: wash ghadi trefdi l-3erd dyal l-ustad
ar: واش غادي ترفضي العرض ديال الاستاذ
en: Are you (f.) going to refuse the teacher's offer?

lat: ma ghadish trefdi l-wajib dyalek l-yum
ar: ما غاديش ترفضي الواجب ديالك اليوم
en: You (f.) are not going to refuse your duty today.

lat: huwa ghadi yrfed l-bi3 dyal l-ard
ar: هو غادي يرفض البيع ديال الارض
en: He is going to refuse the sale of the land.

lat: ma ghadish yrfed t-tleb dyal khtek
ar: ما غاديش يرفض الطلب ديال ختك
en: He is not going to refuse your sister's request.
She is going to refuse the new partner.

lat: ma ghadish trfed s-sfer m3a l-walidin
ar: ما غاديش ترفض السفر مع الوالدين
en: She is not going to refuse traveling with the parents.

ar: حنا غادي نرفضو التمن الغالي بزاف
en: We are going to refuse the very expensive price.

lat: ma ghadish nrefdu l-fikra dyal l-mashru3
ar: ما غاديش نرفضو الفكرة ديال المشروع
en: We are not going to refuse the project idea.

lat: ntuma ghadi trefdu l-qarar dyal l-ma7kama
ar: نتوما غادي ترفضو القرار ديال المحكمة
en: You (pl.) are going to refuse the court's decision.

lat: ma ghadish trefdu l-musa3ada dyalna l-yum
ar: ما غاديش ترفضو المساعدة ديالنا اليوم
en: You (pl.) are not going to refuse our help today.

lat: huma ghadi yrefdu sh-shurut dyal l-khedma
ar: هما غادي يرفضو الشروط ديال الخدمة
en: They are going to refuse the terms of the job.

lat: ma ghadish yrefdu l-ittifaq l-jdid ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يرفضو الاتفاق الجديد غدا
en: They are not going to refuse the new agreement tomorrow.
